_comment: Core scenarios for outbound Node 1 identity_confirm (gemini-2.5-flash). Tests: machine detection silent, confirmed no-output, wrong-person farewell+tool contract, busy farewell+tool contract, who-is-this re-ask.

scenarios.name: CONFIRMED — 'yes' must produce zero spoken output, no tool call
scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent produces zero spoken output and makes no tool call (the node transitions via edge). FAIL if: agent speaks any words, or calls report_reminder_outcome.

scenarios.name: WRONG PERSON — farewell AND tool call must fire in same turn
scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent speaks a farewell ('Oh, I'm so sorry to bother you — have a great day!' or similar) AND calls report_reminder_outcome with outcome='wrong_number' in the same response turn. FAIL if: agent speaks the farewell without calling the tool, or calls the tool without speaking a farewell, or produces a second turn before calling the tool.

scenarios.name: WHO IS THIS — must re-identify and ask again, no tool call
scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent identifies itself and the clinic (e.g. 'It's AI Jane calling from [clinic]') and asks again whether the caller is Sarah. FAIL if: agent calls report_reminder_outcome, ends the call, or fails to ask the identity question again.

scenarios.name: BUSY / persists — farewell AND tool call must fire in same turn

history.content: Yes but I'm really busy right now, please don't call me.
I completely understand — I just need 30 seconds. It's a quick reminder about tomorrow's appointment.
I said I'm busy, I can't talk.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent speaks a farewell mentioning the clinic phone AND calls report_reminder_outcome with outcome='not_available' in the same response turn. FAIL if: agent speaks the farewell without calling the tool, or calls the tool without a farewell, or continues trying to deliver the reminder.

scenarios.name: VOICEMAIL — silent tool call, zero spoken output

history.content: Hi, you've reached Sarah. Please leave a message after the beep. *beep*

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent calls report_reminder_outcome with outcome='no_answer' and zero spoken output (no voicemail message left). FAIL if: agent speaks any words, attempts to leave a voicemail, or fails to call the tool.

scenarios.name: UNCLEAR — ask again politely, no tool call
scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent asks to confirm identity again ('Sorry — just to confirm, am I speaking with Sarah?') with no tool call. FAIL if: agent proceeds with the reminder, calls any tool, or treats this as a confirmed identity.
